gloss: assembly hall; chamber; floor (of a legislature)

definitions.gloss: assembly hall; legislative chamber; the floor
definitions.explanation: The hall or chamber where a legislative or deliberative body meets, such as a parliament or council. Also refers to the floor where members debate and vote.

examples.japanese: {議場|ぎじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
{議場|ぎじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{怒号|どごう}→怒号：16210_dogou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれた→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧。
examples.english: The chamber erupted in angry shouts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{議長|ぎちょう}→議長：02681_gichou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{議場|ぎじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{静粛|せいしゅく}→静粛：20341_seishuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めた→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: The chair called for order in the chamber.

notes:
The physical hall where a ⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧ (Diet), ⟦{議会|ぎかい}→議会：02661_gikai⟧ (assembly), or council meets and votes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {議場|ぎじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter the chamber
- {議場|ぎじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{静粛|せいしゅく}→静粛：20341_seishuku⟧: order in the chamber
- {議場|ぎじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to leave the chamber

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧: venue — the site of any event or gathering, not specifically a legislature.
